name: com.trystarrynightops/recalllens
title: RecallLens
description: US recall lookup: NHTSA vehicle and VIN recalls, FDA food, drug and device recalls, CPSC products.

tools.name: vehicle_recalls
tools.description: Lists NHTSA safety recall campaigns for a US-market vehicle by make, model and model year, newest first: campaign number, report date, component, a short defect summary, the safety risk, the remedy, any "do not drive" or "park outside" advisory, and a link to the NHTSA recall page. If the model name does not match NHTSA's naming, it returns the closest NHTSA model names for that make and year. It covers campaigns issued for the model, not whether a specific vehicle has been repaired.

make.description: Vehicle make, e.g. "Honda", "Chevrolet", "Ford". Short forms such as "Chevy" and "VW" are accepted.

limit.description: Maximum number of campaigns to return (1-50, default 10).

detail.description: "brief" (default) keeps each result short; "full" adds the complete text fields.

tools.name: vin_recalls
tools.description: Checks a 17-character vehicle identification number (VIN): validates its check digit, decodes make, model and model year with NHTSA's vPIC service (only the first 11 characters are sent, or 14 for low-volume manufacturers; never the serial number), then lists the NHTSA safety recall campaigns issued for that make, model and year, with the same fields as vehicle_recalls. It does not confirm whether this specific vehicle is included in a campaign or has been repaired; NHTSA's own VIN lookup at nhtsa.gov/recalls is the official source for that.

vin.description: 17-character VIN, e.g. "1HGCV1F37JA000001". Spaces and dashes are ignored; letters I, O and Q never occur in VINs.

limit.description: Maximum number of campaigns to return (1-50, default 10).

detail.description: "brief" (default) keeps each result short; "full" adds the complete text fields.

tools.name: vehicle_recall_campaign
tools.description: Returns one NHTSA recall campaign by its campaign number (e.g. 20V314000, 20V-314 or 23C001): manufacturer, report date, component, summary, consequence, remedy, potential number of units affected, advisories, and the makes, models and model years it covers. Works for vehicle (V), equipment (E), tire (T) and child seat (C) campaigns.

limit.description: Maximum number of make/model entries to list (1-200, default 40).

detail.description: "brief" (default) keeps each result short; "full" adds the complete text fields.

tools.name: food_drug_device_recalls
tools.description: Searches FDA recall enforcement reports published through openFDA for food, drugs and medical devices, newest report date first. Optional filters: keywords (every word must appear in the product description, reason for recall, recalling firm or lot/code information; "quoted phrases" are kept together), product type, classification (Class I, II or III), status and report-date range. Returns recall number, class, status, firm, product, reason, distribution, dates and a link to the openFDA record. The data is FDA's weekly Enforcement Report (2012 onward), which can lag FDA's recall announcements.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. "peanut butter", "listeria", "insulin pen", a firm name or a lot number. Up to 6 words. Optional.

product_type.description: Limit to one FDA product type. Omit to search all three.

classification.description: FDA recall class. Class I is the most serious.

status.description: Recall status in the Enforcement Report.

limit.description: Results per page (1-25, default 10). At most 10 without product_type or for devices, and at most 5 with detail "full".

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging (0-100). Without product_type, offset + limit can be at most 20.

detail.description: "brief" (default) keeps each result short; "full" adds the complete text fields.

tools.name: consumer_product_recalls
tools.description: Searches US Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) recalls of consumer products such as toys, cribs, strollers, furniture, heaters, e-bikes, batteries and appliances, newest first. Keywords (every word must appear) are matched against the recall title, product names, models and types, description, hazard, firm and retailer names, and UPCs; a CPSC recall number also works. Optional recall-date range. Returns recall number, date, title, products, units, hazard, remedy and the cpsc.gov link. Does not cover vehicles, food, drugs, cosmetics or medical devices.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. "space heater", "IKEA dresser", "magnet", a model number, a UPC or a recall number like 27054. Up to 6 words. Optional if a date range is given.

limit.description: Results per page (1-10, default 10; at most 5 with detail "full").

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging (0-200).

detail.description: "brief" (default) keeps each result short; "full" adds the complete text fields.
